# Recreation Prompt

Create a mobile portrait browser interactive chat game titled **Midnight Triangle: Rain Diary**. Preserve the source mechanic: the player taps through a fixed nine-message conversation, then chooses between two exclusive romance branches and sees an ending overlay with replay. Present it as a satirical forbidden romance fantasy inspired by vampire/werewolf teen melodrama: rainy moonlit forest, immortal longing, supernatural love triangle, obsessive text messages, and overdramatic yearning. Use a self-contained HTML/CSS/JS implementation with procedural canvas rain and pines, a moon-heart phone avatar, large touch-friendly CTA, readable message bubbles, catalog-approved Cinzel/Exo 2 fonts, approved forest/UI audio, and compact GIF feedback. Do not add failure, scoring, combat, navigation, or new mechanics.

Primary steering prompt: Forbidden romance fantasy. A satirical game inspired by Twilight with immortal longing, moody forests, supernatural love triangles, forbidden attraction, melodrama, rain-soaked yearning, and teenage obsession with mobile-first controls, touch-friendly interactions, responsive readability, optimized on game start for portrait UI format, and the best-adapted mobile UX version targeting portrait aspect ratios in the 4:7 to 9:16 range.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Current Game Truth
- genre: mobile-first interactive chat / story choice game
- objective: tap through a fixed alternating conversation until a two-option choice appears, then select one ending and optionally replay
- input model: primary tap/click anywhere in the chat app advances dialogue; choice cards and replay button use their own click/tap handlers
- core loop: boot into chat, tap to reveal nine scripted messages, show choice overlay, select one of two suitors, display result overlay, replay resets messages
- fail/friction state: no loss state; friction is the irreversible branch choice until replay

## Protected Mechanics
- Preserve tap-to-advance scripted message sequencing, two exclusive branch choices, ending overlay, replay reset, audio-unlock-on-user-gesture, haptic calls as optional feedback, and mobile portrait chat readability.
- Preserve no-score/no-fail semantics; the progress meter is a truthful representation of message count, not a new scoring rule.

## Remix Target
Forbidden romance fantasy. A satirical game inspired by Twilight with immortal longing, moody forests, supernatural love triangles, forbidden attraction, melodrama, rain-soaked yearning, and teenage obsession with mobile-first controls, touch-friendly interactions, responsive readability, optimized on game start for portrait UI format, and the best-adapted mobile UX version targeting portrait aspect ratios in the 4:7 to 9:16 range.

The rebuilt game reinterprets the two-choice prom chat as a satirical forbidden supernatural love triangle in a rainy forest. The focal identity is the forbidden phone/moon-heart diary interface mediating two suitors: Lucien Ash, an immortal glittering melodrama vampire, and Rowan Fang, a warm-blooded werewolf rival.
